ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity black pixels across approximately 85-90% of the surface area, with high-intensity white and mid-intensity grey clusters comprising the remaining 10-15%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes. High-contrast grey circular rosette patterns distributed non-uniformly across the central regions of both lobes. High-intensity white and orange-tinted clusters localized at the extreme distal tips (corners) of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate interior angle of 55 degrees with a significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal width of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; pixel-amplitude of peaks varies significantly, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary across the entire trailing edge from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward convex curve for both lobes, terminating in an acute upward-pointing distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous discrete, roughly circular pixel clusters of light grey and white visible against the dark background, most prominent in the medial and distal-middle sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusions and dense, multi-chromatic (white, grey, and ochre) pixel clusters at the distal tips, indicating extreme localized surface irregularity or attached biological matter.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme jaggedness of the trailing edge and the dense accumulation of high-contrast material at the tips provide a unique structural profile for identification.
